procedure: A no-reaction decision-time bundle was frozen; a fresh-context independent annotator read only that bundle and the fixed PD definitions; blind_preexecution_features.jsonl was written and hashed before frozen R labels were joined by the primary analyst.
important_limitations: The independent annotator was blind to downstream R labels and prior PD annotations, but the deficiency descriptions and C4 review evidence were fixed inputs as required.
This is one independent annotation pass, not inter-rater reliability measurement.
Multiple deficiency instances from one case may be causally linked and are not independent samples.
Reaction labels were joined only after the blind artifact hash was fixed; blind PD values were not revised after reveal.
